name: Finework (Hu Nan) New Energy Technology Co., Ltd
summary: Finework (Hu Nan) New Energy Technology Co., Ltd engages in the research, development, manufacture, and sale of fasteners in China and internationally. The company offers superalloy fastener; wind power products; metal seals; impeller; fuel nozzle; gas turbine and helicopter drive shafts; thread rolling die; combustion flame; combustion sheet metal and tubing system; aerocraft engine parts; oilfield equipment parts; nuclear power fastener; API20E and API20F fasteners; precision machining parts; and fabricated parts.
